title: Pre-commit/pre-push hooks and required codegen
answers: What runs on pre-commit and pre-push?
Which codegen must I run after changing serializers or schema?
How do I fix ci:preflight failures?
body:
- `.husky/pre-commit` runs `pnpm lint-staged` (rules in `package.json` `lint-staged`): py → `hogli lint:python:fix`, `hogli format:python`, `ty check`; md → `hogli format:markdown`; templates → `hogli format:html`.
- Editing `products/**/manifest.tsx` triggers `pnpm build:products` and stages regenerated `products.tsx`, `productScenes.tsx`, `products.json`. `frontend/src/lib/constants.tsx` triggers `hogli lint:feature-flags:fix`.
- `.husky/pre-push`: blocks master, blocks merge-queue branches, runs `hogli ci:preflight --strict`; on failure run `hogli ci:preflight --fix`. Never `--no-verify`.
- Codegen: serializers/viewsets → `hogli build:openapi` (never hand-edit `api.schemas.ts`, `api.ts`, `api.zod.ts`); query schema → `hogli build:schema` (json+python); kea logics → `typegen:write` in frontend/package.json (`*Type.ts` files); migrations via `hogli migrations:run`.
applies: Contributor changes touching serializers, query schema, kea logics, product manifests; hooks apply on commit/push.
